verdict.rationale: Square maintains a public `square/connect-api-specification` GitHub repository. Its README (square-docs-19, square-docs-29) implies a downloadable API specification and points users to pre-built clients generated from it. The developer site serves no OpenAPI or Swagger file at any standard path (square-probe-3), so the spec is discoverable only through the GitHub repo, and the evidence never confirms its format or currency. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the file is OpenAPI/Swagger, a spec served at a well-known URL on the developer portal, evidence the spec is current and complete, independent hands-on corroboration.
